request.question: Compare the original Qwen and ChatGLM3 releases using their Chinese and English project descriptions and technical reports. Use at least two Chinese-language and two English-language sources from the frozen corpus. Reconcile equivalent statements without double-counting translated claims; cite each language separately and identify publisher dependence.
